candidates.title: [ux-sim] Internship pages never say if it is paid, what the job is or who can apply; prep-crew features sit above the job facts
candidates.body:
> **AI 시뮬레이션 — 실제 사용자 측정이 아닌 가설.** 이탈 가능성은 가설로만 적습니다.

> **AI simulation — hypotheses, not measured user behaviour.** Curated from AI personas driving a real browser — a hypothesis to confirm with real students, not measured behaviour.

### Problem

Both internship personas reached a details page (goal met) but could not tell pay, duties or eligibility ("Graduate Intern" for an undergrad?). "Do it with people / Start a prep crew" comes before the job facts.

Severity **2** (Moderate — slowed me down or made me hesitate; I recovered on my own.) · analyst confidence high · **2 simulated persona(s)** across 1 scenario(s).

### Root cause (hypothesis)

Imported listings carry only title, place, field and a link; the page leads with social features instead of the facts students check first.

### Evidence

- run `sched-20261104-1915-marcus-internship-near-berkeley` step 10 — “I don't need a 'prep crew', I need to know if it pays. Why is that stuff” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261104-1915-marcus-internship-near-berkeley/shots/010-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261104-1915-marcus-internship-near-berkeley/shots/010-click-som.jpg)
- run `sched-20261104-1915-marcus-internship-near-berkeley` step 12 — “But nothing says if it's paid or what I'd actually do.” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261104-1915-marcus-internship-near-berkeley/shots/012-scroll.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261104-1915-marcus-internship-near-berkeley/shots/012-scroll-som.jpg)
- run `sched-20261104-1915-diego-internship-near-berkeley` step 17 — “'Software Graduate Intern' — that's probably for grad students, I'm an undergrad. And still no pay anywhere.” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261104-1915-diego-internship-near-berkeley/shots/017-scroll.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261104-1915-diego-internship-near-berkeley/shots/017-scroll-som.jpg)

Runs: [`sched-20261104-1915-marcus-internship-near-berkeley`](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261104-1915-marcus-internship-near-berkeley/report.md), [`sched-20261104-1915-diego-internship-near-berkeley`](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261104-1915-diego-internship-near-berkeley/report.md)

### Who

Personas: `marcus-senior-lowtech`, `diego-transfer-commuter` · scenarios: `internship-near-berkeley`

### Environment note

Same on live (opportunities come from the live snapshot).

### Suggested fix (hypothesis)

Put a facts block first (Paid/Unpaid/Unknown, level: undergrad/grad, one-line summary) and move prep crews below; show "Pay: see posting" when unknown.

### Note

Severity and persona counts describe simulated personas, not rates of real students. Re-run the affected cells after a fix and compare (docs/ux-sim/ORCHESTRATE.md).

candidates.title: [ux-sim] Rides is not on Home or in onboarding; students find it only at the bottom of Social › Meetups
candidates.body:
> **AI 시뮬레이션 — 실제 사용자 측정이 아닌 가설.** 이탈 가능성은 가설로만 적습니다.

> **AI simulation — hypotheses, not measured user behaviour.** Curated from AI personas driving a real browser — a hypothesis to confirm with real students, not measured behaviour.

### Problem

Diego (today) and Seoyeon (2026-11-03) both searched for rides; it sits under "More ways to meet". Once found, the Rides page worked very well.

Severity **2** (Moderate — slowed me down or made me hesitate; I recovered on my own.) · analyst confidence high · **1 simulated persona(s)** across 1 scenario(s).

### Root cause (hypothesis)

Rides is filed as a social feature; Home tiles and onboarding goals never mention it.

### Evidence

- run `sched-20261104-1915-diego-ride-sfo-thanksgiving` step 0 — “OK, where's rides? Events, opportunities, clubs, meetups... nothing says ride or carpool.” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261104-1915-diego-ride-sfo-thanksgiving/shots/000-start.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261104-1915-diego-ride-sfo-thanksgiving/shots/000-start-som.jpg)
- run `sched-20261104-1915-diego-ride-sfo-thanksgiving` step 4 — “There it is — Rides. Buried at the bottom of Social > Meetups though.” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261104-1915-diego-ride-sfo-thanksgiving/shots/004-scroll.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261104-1915-diego-ride-sfo-thanksgiving/shots/004-scroll-som.jpg)

### Who

### Environment note

Same on live (opportunities come from the live snapshot).

### Suggested fix (hypothesis)

Add a Rides tile on Home (at least around breaks) and mention rides in "Make campus life easier".

### Note

Severity and persona counts describe simulated personas, not rates of real students. Re-run the affected cells after a fix and compare (docs/ux-sim/ORCHESTRATE.md).
